constraints.text: The Kokoro-FastAPI LaunchAgent is written by lspeak's own install, never by chezmoi, because chezmoi pushes Library/LaunchAgents to every darwin host and the venv exists only here.
The service binds 127.0.0.1, not start-gpu_mac.sh's 0.0.0.0; the server has no auth.

The Mac start script exports USE_GPU, PYTHONPATH, MODEL_DIR, VOICES_DIR, WEB_PLAYER_PATH, DEVICE_TYPE=mps and PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK (lines 7-15) before running uvicorn api.src.main:app (line 20).
Drainer: flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB or exit; drain in name order re-listing after each item; unlock; re-check the dir and loop if non-empty.
A failed queue item is logged to ~/.local/state/lspeak/lspeak.log and removed, never retried forever.
-o PATH writes the file and only then exits.
--provider system -o briefing-<date>.mp3 writes WAV bytes into the .mp3 path, keeping prismis's existing behavior.
Any flag not in the kept set is refused, naming it; elevenlabs and --model are refused naming that they were dropped (lines 58, 61).
.sable/ is untracked and not ours; leave it alone.
The old pronunciation rewrite applies re.sub(rf"\b{re.escape(word)}\b", f"[{word}](/{ipa}/)") per entry in config (TOML) order; Python str \b is Unicode-aware.

Go's regexp \b is ASCII-only and Go maps iterate in random order, so a faithful port needs Unicode word-boundary checks and must apply entries in file order (toml.MetaData.Keys), or a key like 'José' or overlapping keys behave differently from the old tool.
rudy's config sets Rudy = "ɹˈudi" under [tts.pronunciation], provider kokoro, voice bf_emma, plus now-dead [http] and [cache] tables the new client must tolerate.
bench's Stop hook runs lspeak -- <sentence> once per sentence and awaits each, so per-call latency is paid per sentence.
The classifier spawns lspeak -- <title> detached with ignored stdio.
bench daemon dispatch runs lspeak <line> with no -- and treats a non-zero exit as failure.
momentum passes --no-cache, --provider, --voice, --cache-threshold and --model (lines 366-386); it was last committed 2026-08-23 and is not referenced in ~/.claude/settings.json.
prismis polls up to 30 s for the -o file after lspeak exits, and defaults audio_provider to system (line 229).
POST /v1/audio/speech accepts response_format mp3|opus|aac|flac|wav|pcm.
Kokoro-FastAPI's text normalizer may treat [Rudy](/ɹˈudi/) as literal text even though the request returns 200, so only rudy's listen check (D5.4) settles it.
Once go.mod exists ember's gate runs go vet ./..., staticcheck ./..., gofmt -l . (fails on any output) and go test ./... (lines 322-332).
bench.tts.enabled is false today and must stay false until every D5 proof holds.

issues.why: -o with a relative path saved into the old daemon's cwd and printed success regardless; a synchronous, daemon-free -o resolved in the caller's own cwd answers both defects, so this work closes it.
